CREATE TABLE D360.EDS_D30_TRANSACTIONREPORT
WITH (	DISTRIBUTION = HASH([CIF ID]),HEAP)
AS
SELECT * FROM [EDS].[D30_TRANSACTIONREPORT]

CREATE TABLE [d360].[STG_EDS_D30_TRANSACTIONREPORT]
(
	[H] [varchar](25) NULL,
	[UserName]	varchar(150),
	[Account_Name]	varchar(200),
	[Channel_ID]	varchar(10),
	[Transaction_Date]	date,
	[Transaction_Time]	time(7),
	[Transaction_Reference_Number]	varchar(25),
	[Originator_Account]	varchar(20),
	[Beneficial_Account_Number]	varchar(150),
	[Transferee_Name]	varchar(100),
	[Biller_Mnemonic]	varchar(10),
	[Bank_Code]	varchar(25),
	[Transferee_Bank]	varchar(100),
	[Transaction_Category]	varchar(25),
	[Transaction_Type]	varchar(100),
	[Subscriber_Account_Number]	varchar(30),
	[Transaction_Currency]	varchar(10),
	[Transaction_Amount]	NUMERIC(18,4),--numeric
	[Service_Currency]	varchar(5),
	[Service_Fee]	NUMERIC(10,4),--numeric
	[Occurence]	varchar(25),
	[Device_Model]	varchar(200),
	[IPAddress]	varchar(25),
	[Status]	varchar(20),
	[Confirmation_Reference]	varchar(50),
	[Payment_Reference]	varchar(50),
	[Response_Code]	varchar(10),
	[Logged_Date]	date,
	[Logged_Time]	time(7),
	[CIF_ID]	varchar(15),
	[Account_Type]	varchar(25),
	[Product_Type]	varchar(50),
	[Terminator]	varchar(100),
	[File_name]	varchar(100),
	[insert_dttm]	datetime2

)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)

CREATE TABLE [EDS].[D30_TRANSACTIONREPORT]
( 
	[UserName]	varchar(150),
	[Account_Name]	varchar(200),
	[Channel_ID]	varchar(10),
	[Transaction_Date]	date,
	[Transaction_Time]	time(7),
	[Transaction_Reference_Number]	varchar(25),
	[Originator_Account]	varchar(20),
	[Beneficial_Account_Number]	varchar(150),
	[Transferee_Name]	varchar(100),
	[Biller_Mnemonic]	varchar(10),
	[Bank_Code]	varchar(25),
	[Transferee_Bank]	varchar(100),
	[Transaction_Category]	varchar(25),
	[Transaction_Type]	varchar(100),
	[Subscriber_Account_Number]	varchar(30),
	[Transaction_Currency]	varchar(10),
	[Transaction_Amount]	NUMERIC(18,4),--numeric
	[Service_Currency]	varchar(5),
	[Service_Fee]	NUMERIC(10,4),--numeric
	[Occurence]	varchar(25),
	[Device_Model]	varchar(200),
	[IPAddress]	varchar(25),
	[Status]	varchar(20),
	[Confirmation_Reference]	varchar(50),
	[Payment_Reference]	varchar(50),
	[Response_Code]	varchar(10),
	[Logged_Date]	date,
	[Logged_Time]	time(7),
	[CIF_ID]	varchar(15),
	[Account_Type]	varchar(25),
	[Product_Type]	varchar(50),
	[Terminator]	varchar(100),
	[BNK_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = HASH([CIF_ID]),
	HEAP
);

INSERT INTO EDS.D30_TRANSACTIONREPORT (
	UserName
	,Account_Name
	,Channel_ID
	,Transaction_Date
	,Transaction_Time
	,Transaction_Reference_Number
	,Originator_Account
	,Beneficial_Account_Number
	,Transferee_Name
	,Biller_Mnemonic
	,Bank_Code
	,Transferee_Bank
	,Transaction_Category
	,Transaction_Type
	,Subscriber_Account_Number
	,Transaction_Currency
	,Transaction_Amount
	,Service_Currency
	,Service_Fee
	,Occurence
	,Device_Model
	,IPAddress
	,Status
	,Confirmation_Reference
	,Payment_Reference
	,Response_Code
	,Logged_Date
	,Logged_Time
	,CIF_ID
	,Account_Type
	,Product_Type
	,Terminator
	,BNK_CODE
	,SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,insert_dttm
)
SELECT
[UserName]
,[Account Name]
,[Channel ID]
,[Transaction Date]
,[Transaction Time]
,[Transaction Reference Number]
,[Originator Account]
,[Beneficial Account Number]
,[Transferee Name]
,[Biller Mnemonic]
,[Bank Code]
,[Transferee Bank]
,[Transaction Category]
,[Transaction Type]
,[Subscriber Account Number]
,[Transaction Currency]
,[Transaction Amount]
,[Service Currency]
,[Service Fee]
,[Occurence]
,[Device Model]
,[IPAddress]
,[Status]
,[Confirmation Reference]
,[Payment Reference]
,[Response Code]
,[Logged Date]
,[Logged Time]
,[CIF ID]
,[Account Type]
,[Product Type]
,[Terminator]
,'CBC01' BNK_CODE
,'D30' SOURCE_CODE
,'D30_TRANSACTIONREPORT_' + concat(YEAR(cast([Transaction Date] as date)),right(concat('00',Month(cast([Transaction Date] as date))),2)) FILE_NAME
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) as insert_dttm
FROM  [D360].[EDS_D30_TRANSACTIONREPORT]
